title: Quickstart journey mockups for enterprise outreach
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a set of polished deck-ready visuals and annotated screenshots that communicate the Redwood console quickstart and Dedicated/Private deployment flows for outbound enterprise outreach. Deliverables should include 3 hero 16:9 slides, step-by-step montage, cropped annotated screenshots for callouts, and a small library of export-ready SVG/PNG icons and overlays. Emphasize clarity for Solutions Engineers and Sales during short demos.
acceptance_criteria: Three hero slides (16:9) illustrating Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private onboarding flows, exportable as PNG and PDF
Step-by-step montage of console first-time flow with annotations and copy stubs for slide text
Set of 8 cropped screenshots (1280x720) with blurred PII and annotated callouts
Figma file with named components, variant states (light/dark), and export presets
Hand-off notes for Solutions Engineers including recommended demo prompts and expected latencies
design_notes: Prefer real console screenshots over stylized illustrations to build trust for enterprise buyers
Use Redwood brand blue for callouts, 48px safe margin on hero slides, and maximize real-token usage examples without revealing customer data
Create a ‘deploy decision’ visual that compares Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private with cost/latency icons
Include alternative copy options for privacy-conscious customers that highlight VPC/KMS features
